about: The six pictures of the Home's area cards (src/components/HomeAreas.astro): the owner's files, byte for byte as supplied (AI-generated: see provenance).
treatment: None. The files are not cropped, resized, recoloured or recompressed here, and the page applies no filter, blend mode, overlay or opacity to them: they show in their own colours. Only astro:assets, at build time, serves them in smaller sizes and in WebP. A first version (V2.3) had been toned to each card's colour inside the files themselves; that was rejected and removed (V2.3.1), and a test now keeps the files equal to the owner's.

c2pa.generator: ChatGPT (gpt-image), through the OpenAI Media Service API
c2pa.created: 2026-10-24, between 15:19 and 15:23 UTC (the timestamps of the six manifests)

provenance.note: The files carry a signed C2PA manifest (Content Credentials): they are images generated by an AI model, not photographs or scans of existing works. An earlier version of this note said they carry no metadata: that was wrong (the reader used did not show this chunk). That they are AI-generated, and that the owner has the right to publish them, is for the owner to confirm and decide (including whether the site should say so); until then the status stays unconfirmed. Content shown in them (the equations of the blackboard, the text on the code screen) was not checked and is not the site's content.

ground.note: Mean of the flat cream at the top and bottom edges of the original (std about 3 levels). The picture is wider than the card (3:2), and cover would cut both heads and half the bubble, so it is shown whole and the card continues this ground.
